# Clear Price v1.2.0

**Two discounts, one honest answer.** Open it, type a price and a percentage or
two, and see what you really pay.

$89 with 20% off, then another 70% off the reduced price → **$21.36**, and you
saved **$67.64** (76% off). Adding the percentages instead — what most
calculators do — would say $8.90 and be wrong by $12.46.

## Get it

**[▶ Open Clear Price](https://jameroy21.github.io/clear-price/)** and add it to
your home screen:

- **iPhone / Safari** — **Share** → **Add to Home Screen**
- **Android / Chrome** — menu **⋮** → **Install app** (or **Add to Home screen**)

It installs as its own app — name, green tag icon and iOS launch screen, not a
browser bookmark — and after the first visit it works with **no signal**, which
is the situation it was built for. The maths runs on the phone; nothing is sent
anywhere.

Offline copy: **`clear-price-v1.2.0.zip`** below is the complete source for this
version, with a `.sha256` beside it. Unzip it, or use GitHub's own
*Source code (zip)* link, which is generated from the same tag.

## What is in this version

**The app**

- Two discounts applied sequentially the way shops do it, rounded half-to-even —
  the same rule on the phone and on the server, verified on **8,001** cases.
- Big-type, high-contrast screen: 18 px minimum text, a 32 px result, decimal
  keypad on phones, dark mode, keyboard and screen-reader support.
- Works offline; installs to the home screen with a branded icon, name and
  launch screen; one-tap share.
- Ownership shown in the product: licence, terms, privacy notice and a footer
  reading *© 2026 Jame Roy. All rights reserved.*

**Delivery**

- The install address is **GitHub Pages**, static and free, deploying from
  `main` on every push (`.github/workflows/pages.yml`).
- The same app can also run against the FastAPI service on Render, which adds
  the anonymous install counter — see [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md).
- No accounts, no email, no phone number, no cookies on the Pages build.

**Anonymous counting (API build only)**

- `POST /track` records *that* a device installed or opened the app; the device
  id is stored only as an HMAC-SHA256 digest, and counting can be switched off
  in the footer, with `Do Not Track` / `Global Privacy Control` honoured.
- `GET /stats/summary` tells the owner how many devices installed, how many came
  back, and the 14-day trend — no login required.

**Hardening**

- Strict validation (`extra="forbid"`, price > 0, percentages 0–100), body-size
  and rate limits, trust-proxy-aware client IPs, and a security header set
  (CSP, HSTS, `no-store` on the API) on every response.

## Known limitations, honestly

- The optional free API host sleeps after ~15 minutes idle; its first request
  then takes 30–60 seconds. The app falls back to on-device maths instead of
  showing an error.
- Install counts on a free host live on an ephemeral disk and reset on redeploy.
- A home-screen *widget* is not possible for a web app on either platform; the
  Shortcuts (iOS) and long-press shortcut (Android) routes in
  [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) get you one tap away.
